executable.title: Generate Segment Rulers
executable.description: Add diameter rulers to segments without rulers.

parameters.label: Input and output
parameters.description: Annotated volume, its segments, and the generated rulers.

image.name: inputVolume
image.label: Input Volume
image.description: Volume that receives the generated rulers.

image.name: inputLabelmap
image.label: Input Label Map
image.description: Painted scalar integer label maps. Embedded segment names supply ruler labels; zero is background.

file.name: outputAnnotations
file.label: Output Annotations
file.description: New rulers labeled with their segment name. Any ruler for a segment suppresses generation.

parameters.label: Existing annotations
parameters.description: The rulers already on the image, which this task preserves.

file.name: inputAnnotations
file.label: Input Annotations
file.description: Optional rulers for the input volume.

parameters.label: Girder API
parameters.description: Server access injected by slicer_cli_web; not shown to users.
